snippet.title: Rogue: Tempted to Touch | Character Reveal | Marvel Rivals
snippet.description:
A Mutant whose power can change the course of any battle - and whose touch rewrites the rules of the fight itself.

Anna Marie's unique ability lets her absorb the power of others, turning their strength into her own. But everything changed the moment she came into contact with Gambit's Chronovium die. Its unstable energy pushed her abilities beyond known limits, unleashing a force powerful enough to shatter everything

Season 5.5 begins on December 12 (UTC).

The wait is over. Her power is real. Time to go Rogue.
